name: Zoho WorkDrive
description: Zoho WorkDrive is a cloud file-management and content-collaboration platform for teams and organizations. People use it to store and organize files, work together in shared team folders, collect submissions, manage document workflows, and control how business content is shared.
agentUseSummary: Connect a Zoho WorkDrive account once, then let agents use every selected operation in Zoho's official WorkDrive API under Safe or Dangerous policy.

capabilities.label: Read WorkDrive
capabilities.description: Use all 90 documented WorkDrive retrieval operations for teams, content, sharing, comments, collections, labels, templates, workflows, and policy metadata.

capabilities.label: Manage files and collaboration
capabilities.description: Use every documented non-admin content, upload, folder, share, comment, collection, label, and workflow mutation.

capabilities.label: Administer WorkDrive
capabilities.description: Use every documented team, member, group, team-folder, data-template, library, and data-policy mutation when the connected Zoho account permits it.

allowed.label: Read Zoho WorkDrive
allowed.description: Run one exact documented WorkDrive GET operation from the pinned official specification.

approvalRequired.label: Manage WorkDrive content
approvalRequired.description: Run one exact documented content or collaboration mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalRequired.label: Administer Zoho WorkDrive
approvalRequired.description: Run one exact documented administrative mutation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: All 90 bounded WorkDrive reads run directly; every content, collaboration, workflow, destructive, or administrative mutation requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: All 229 selected and Zoho-authorized WorkDrive operations run without Relay per-action approval; connection ownership, regional origins, exact routes, scopes, bounds, audits, redaction, and Zoho account authority still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts the selected pinned WorkDrive operations through the authenticated server-side connector.
Railway mounts the selected pinned WorkDrive operations through the authenticated server-side connector.

providerSetup.blocker: Relay's production multi-data-center Zoho web client, exact callback, 66 reviewed scopes, client ID, client secret, and production authorization are not configured on Railway.
providerSetup.nextAction: Create a Relay Console web client in Zoho API Console, enable Multi-DC with shared credentials, register https://api.relayconsole.work/api/v1/marketplace/oauth/zoho-workdrive/callback, configure ZOHO_WORKDRIVE_CLIENT_ID and ZOHO_WORKDRIVE_CLIENT_SECRET on Railway, then verify OAuth, regional binding, refresh, reads, Safe approvals, Dangerous mutations, revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Zoho's official OpenAPI 3.0.1 specification identifies 229 authenticated WorkDrive operations: 90 reads and 139 mutations across user, content, sharing, collaboration, workflow, template, team, and policy surfaces.
Zoho documents a multi-user web application authorization-code flow, exact registered redirect URI, offline refresh tokens, comma-separated scopes, consent, and regional Accounts servers.
Zoho documents nine regional WorkDrive API domains and requires each connection to use the data-center domain associated with its account.
Zoho documents connected-app registration, authorization-code tokens, refresh, revocation, and multi-data-center OAuth clients.
